# NBC

> > NBC's official website featuring casting opportunities for popular competition shows including America's Got Talent, The Voice, and Weakest Link.

NBC (National Broadcasting Company) is a major American television network offering entertainment programming, news, and sports. This section of the site provides information about casting calls and audition opportunities for NBC's talent competition series.

- America's Got Talent
- The Voice
- Weakest Link
- Jane Lynch
- casting calls
- tv show auditions
- talent competition
- contestant applications
- NBC shows
- reality TV casting

## Casting & Auditions

- [Now Casting - Annie LIVE and More](https://www.nbc.com/global/pages/casting): Casting calls and audition info for NBC shows like The Voice and AGT
